claim.summary: Over any field, for a polynomial-ring retraction rho with rho(F0)=1, every Hilbert-like certificate sum c_i F_i=1 has a Koszul-syzygy-equivalent representative with rho(C')=Y0: c'_i=c_i-rho(c_i)F0 for i>0 and c'_0=c0+sum_(i>0)rho(c_i)F_i. For a coordinate restriction, a size-S depth-d circuit and shared generator size G/depth Delta yield size O((q+1)S+G+q+1), depth at most max(d,Delta)+4 and coefficient degree at most L+g. Applied to Boolean matrix rank with B=0, the entire restricted certificate is one placeholder, including all Boolean coefficients.
claim.assessment: Elementary explicit normalization, valid for polynomial Hilbert-likeness without syntactic linearity. The degree/circuit bounds concern coordinate restrictions; a general retraction has only the algebraic assertion. This defeats the specified universal zero-factor coefficient extraction, not all certificate-size methods or general IPS.

claim.summary: For any unsatisfiable binary CNF with no empty clause and q a power of two, clause coefficients A_i=f_i^(q-1) product_(j<i)(1-f_j^q) give sum A_i f_i=1-P^q, P=product(1-f_i) nonzero formally. The residual has every Hasse derivative of order less than q zero at all Boolean points. These are constant-depth arithmetic candidates of size polynomial in q and CNF length, but not IPS certificates.
claim.assessment: Symbolic telescoping/Frobenius control of fixed-order jet shortcuts. Does not obstruct tests whose order exceeds the candidate degree or supply Boolean correction coefficients.
